messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service `inference-autoscaler` (P1)
pagerduty: Alert triggered — incident id PD-87342
pagerduty: Alert assigned to on-call: sam
sam: ACK — taking it. seeing spike in request queue depth and delayed dequeues. screens: https://redwood.ops/dashboard/alerts/PD-87342 :eyes:
sam: Metrics snapshot: queue_depth=18,340, avg_dequeue_ms=12000, 99p_token_latency=1.2s, failed_provisions=42m
sam: trying to fetch controller events...
sam: ```
W 13:42:01 controller.go:245 ProvisionNodes failed: provider error: quotaExceeded: Node quota reached for region us-central1
W 13:42:10 controller.go:245 ProvisionNodes failed: provider error: quotaExceeded: Node quota reached for region us-central1
```
dina: I can confirm cloud nodepool max_size=50. looks like we've hit autoscaling ceiling.
chao: Can we divert traffic to dedicated-reserved pool or to us-west-2 standby?
sam: attempted `kubectl get hpa -n infra autoscaler-controller -o yaml` shows target=200k tokens/s; currentReplicas=48; no more nodes available.
sam: attempted manual scale: `gcloud container node-pools update redwood-default --cluster=prod --max-nodes=60` -> got 403 quota issue from provider (quota request required)
opsbot: Runbook excerpt: if quota prevents autoscale -> (1) open cloud quota request, (2) provision temporary smaller instances in fallback pool, (3) adjust routing to dedicated pools, (4) throttle non-critical workloads.
maya: I'm available. I'll open a quota request + spin up temporary instances in standby pool. doing step 1 now.
maya: Opening support ticket to GCP -> ticket 12345678. also creating temporary nodepool small-nodes-ephemeral.
infra-runner: Created nodepool small-nodes-ephemeral size=10, instance-type=n1-standard-4. nodes provisioning (ETA ~4m).
sam: in parallel enabling routing policy to shift 30% to dedicated-reserved to reduce pressure:
sam: ```
route_policy:
  match: path.startswith("/v1/generate")
  actions:
    - weighted_forward:
        targets:
          - pool: hosted-primary
            weight: 70
          - pool: dedicated-reserved
            weight: 30
```
dina: customer impact: hosted text-generation experiencing 5xx and 504s for heavy customers. Notifying account teams: ACME Corp, LexiHealth, SparkDocs. escalation: high-touch outreach.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Escalation queued to SRE lead Dina in 5m if not resolved.
opsbot: Tip: consider enabling model-variant fallback to 7B q4 to reduce memory per-request.
maya: New nodes started registering: nodes_ready=6/10 -> backlog dropping 18,340 -> 3,120
sam: nice. I'll run a sanity check on dequeues and error rates.
sam: dequeues per sec back to nominal, error rate 5xx -> 0.8% (was 12%). system latency 99p -> 300ms.
sam: I'm OOO in ~20m. handing to @maya for continued monitoring and cleanup. if backlog >5k escalate to Dina.
maya: ACK. monitoring logs and will coordinate follow-up postmortem. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident marked resolved by manual mitigation (nodepool bump + temporary pool + weighted routing). Follow-up: quota increase request and runbook update assigned to infra team.
